question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded Control UI composer modal for long prompts, or handle this friction through inline composer growth and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing composition mode and draft workflow rather than fixing a broken current contract, so maintainers need to choose the UX direction before implementation.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth, resizing, and the existing shortcut preference without adding another composition mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by product decision if Control UI composition should remain inline-only for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and own the strongest adjacent send-shortcut decision signal.
